answer: Harberger-tax plot bond: each identity claims a juniper plot on a public ridge register, values it at 250 and pays 25 tax per epoch; undervalue it and auditors may buy it. A violet tag marks each plot, one key each; reuse voids both claims. First filing is 46, the k-th 46+9(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 4,541,500 against a 40,000 pool. Renting fails: the lender's tag is seized with the renter's bond. An honest agent pays 46 once, keeps a full share.
